title: Cyrus, God's Instrument

questions.question: Thus says the LORD to his anointed, to whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:1 (ESV): "Thus says the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus,"

questions.question: I will go before you and level the exalted places, I will break in pieces the doors of bronze and cut through the bars of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:2 (ESV): "and cut through the bars of iron,"

questions.question: I form light and create darkness; I make well-being and create what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:7 (ESV): "I make well-being and create calamity;"

questions.question: Woe to him who strives with him who formed him, a pot among earthen pots! Does the clay say to him who forms it, "What are you what?"
Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:22 (ESV): "For I am God, and there is no other."

questions.question: For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel my chosen, I call you by your name, I name you, though you do not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:4 (ESV): "though you do not know me."

questions.question: I am the LORD, and there is no other, besides me there is no what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:5 (ESV): "besides me there is no God;"

questions.question: Shower, O heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain down what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:8 (ESV): "let the clouds rain down righteousness;"

questions.question: I made the earth and created man on it; it was my hands that stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:12 (ESV): "and I commanded all their host."

questions.question: He shall build my city and set my exiles free, not for price or reward, says the whom?
Truly, you are a God who hides himself, O God of Israel, the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:15 (ESV): "O God of Israel, the Savior."

questions.question: For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens (he is God!), who formed the earth and made it (he established it; he did not create it empty, he formed it to be what?):
questions.explanation: Isaiah 45:18 (ESV): "he formed it to be inhabited!):"

questions.question: I did not speak in secret, in a land of darkness; I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, "Seek me in what?"
By myself I have sworn; from my mouth has gone out in righteousness a word that shall not return: "To me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall what?"
Only in the LORD, it shall be said of me, are righteousness and what?

key_verse_text: Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.
